notes: Stride: long, loping strides, little squash, swinging arms and paws. Starting values from the round's profile table, to be tuned by playing. K3 (gaits): Godot's spring drag damps a part's world velocity, like air, so a travelling body leaves its springs streaming behind at sin = 2 x damping ratio x speed / (2 pi f x segment), and the controller's 6 m/s2 starts throw soft springs past 90 degrees; the springs here are stiffer and less dragged so parts lag and settle without flipping.
